children: China's state planner said on Friday it will increase retail price caps on petrol and diesel from September 12 by 260 yuan ($38.76) and 250 yuan per metric ton respectively.
The National Development and Reform Commission had reduced the caps to mitigate the impact of rising international oil prices on the domestic market.
